verdict.rationale: Gecko documents a public v1 API for triggering scans, reading scan, repository and vulnerability data, triaging findings, managing schedules, rotating tokens and receiving webhooks. It also has API-key management with usage logging, and a probe confirmed a live OpenAPI spec at /openapi.json. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of API usage (community evidence covers only the UI).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Gecko's v1 API lets you trigger scans, read scan, repository, and vulnerability data, triage findings, manage scan schedules, rotate your GitLab token, and receive webhook events
API keys are now visible to the whole team with owner attribution and per-request usage logging
